title: Transfer ownership of a NSW-registered vehicle
summary: This page explains the process and requirements for updating Transport for NSW records when the ownership of a NSW-registered vehicle changes.
intro:
When the ownership of a NSW-registered vehicle changes Transport for NSW needs to update its records. To do this, it requires:

The notice of disposal and vehicle registration transfer can be done online. However for some vehicle transfers:
who_can_apply: The ownership of a NSW-registered vehicle must be changing.
The transfer can involve buying a vehicle from another state or territory, or moving to NSW with a vehicle.
what_you_need: For general transfers, the notice of disposal and vehicle registration transfer can be done online.
For vehicle gifts and inheritances, you may need proof of purchase, which can be provided online or at a service centre.
For businesses, the buyer must transfer the vehicle registration, and the seller must submit a notice of disposal.

faqs.q: How can I transfer vehicle ownership?
faqs.a: The notice of disposal and vehicle registration transfer can be done online.

faqs.q: What are the specific procedures for different types of transfers?
faqs.a: Specific procedures are available for motor vehicle duty, vehicle gifts and inheritances, transfers involving spouses/partners/family, deaths, carers/guardians, interstate vehicles, businesses, and consignment sales.
